typography.guidelines: Use Playfair Display for all main headings to provide a distinctive, warm, editorial feel (like a travel magazine). Use DM Sans for body text, data, and UI elements to maintain high readability. Avoid generic fonts like Inter for headings.

colors.guidelines: Adopt an 'Organic & Earthy' archetype. Avoid standard corporate SaaS blue/white. Use Sandy Beige (#FDFBF7) as the primary background. Use Terracotta (#E25822) or Sunset Orange (#F97316) for primary actions (CTAs). Deep Teal (#0B4F6C) can be used for secondary elements or high-contrast sections. Never use pure black (#000000); use Dark Charcoal (#1A1A1A).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use subtle glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px border-white/40) for sticky headers over hero images. For dashboard cards, use flat backgrounds with a subtle border (border-[#EAE3D9]) and gentle shadows on hover (shadow-lg, -translate-y-1).
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle grain overlays on large colored sections to avoid digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight) for a high-end, premium look. For UI data sections, Phosphor Regular is also acceptable. Do not use emoji as icons.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or softly rounded (rounded-xl) with interaction animations. Primary buttons use Terracotta with white text.
components.cards: For destinations: Image-heavy, minimal padding on the image, content overlapping or immediately below. For dashboard widgets: Clean, dense, subtle borders.
components.navigation: Sticky header with glassmorphism over the hero section, transitioning to solid beige background on scroll. Desktop must have visible links, not just a hamburger.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to fit the warm theme (rounded-xl, beige-tinted borders, terracotta focus rings).
components.toasts: Use 'sonner' for toast notifications, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.

grids.marketing_sections: Use The 'Bento' Grid Protocol (Asymmetry). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with gap-8. Mix tall, square, and wide spans to create visual tension and avoid boring equal squares.
grids.dashboard_sections: High Density Grid. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for section padding. For containers with borders, ensure internal padding (p-6) prevents text collision.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content. Center-align hero text only if it balances the image. Optical alignment > strict geometric alignment.
layouts.mobile_first: Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Use max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none.

motion.interactions: All interactive elements need hover states (color shift, subtle lift).
motion.page_transitions: Smooth transitions on page load or section scroll. Use framer-motion for staggering entrance of destination cards.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the main hero image. Can be achieved with framer-motion or CSS background-attachment: fixed (cautiously on mobile).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has a gradient overlay (e.g., bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 to-transparent) or text-shadow to meet WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs and buttons, utilizing the primary terracotta color.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid="booking-submit-button").

media.hero_overlay: Max overlay opacity bg-black/40. If text needs more contrast, use a gradient overlay, never a flat blanket that kills the image.
media.treatment: Images should feel warm, color-graded towards sunset/golden hour.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for smooth 2D transitions and parallax. Avoid heavy 3D rendering (like R3F) to keep booking flows fast and conversion-focused, unless adding a specific interactive globe for the 'Destination Hub' (react-globe.gl could be considered, but 2D maps with Mapbox are often better for booking utility).

hero_destinations.description: Large, breathtaking travel destinations with sunset hues for the landing page hero.

group_travel.description: Images depicting groups of people enjoying nature/adventure for the Group Travel Planner section.

transport_trains.description: Scenic train journeys for the train booking or transport hub.

hotels.description: Luxury hotel room views for the hotel booking section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Use Shadcn components for complex interactive logic (forms, dialogs, calendars).
Ensure the application is mobile-first responsive. Most travelers use the app mid-trip on their phones.
Implement a personalized dashboard feeling. 'Welcome back, [Name]' with recently viewed/saved trips.
For the Group Planner, create clean debt settlement UI (e.g., 'Ravi owes ₹1,200') with high contrast.
Do NOT use pure black or white. Use the defined warm palette.
Install required icon library: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
For fonts, import Playfair Display and DM Sans from Google Fonts in index.css or via next/font if using Next.js (Note: use .js/.jsx conventions as requested).
Do not use generic blue SaaS colors. Stick to the Terracotta/Teal/Beige palette.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
